description: Vet a package-manager command before running it: installs (npm/pnpm/yarn/bun add or install) and commands that download and run a package on the spot (npx, npm exec, npm create / npm init <x>, pnpm dlx, yarn dlx, bunx). Checks every package involved for non-existence, typosquatting, and install-time scripts on packages with no track record. Call this before running any such command, especially one copied from documentation, a README or a skill file.

command.description: The full shell command, e.g. 'npm install axios zod' or 'npx create-vite@latest app'.

cwd.description: Project directory. When given, an unpinned npx of a bin the project already has installed is skipped.

name: check_install_command
